sensor_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the source sensor.

*See also: [Analog Threshold Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/analog_threshold#configuration-variables)*

lower.docs:
**float**: Lower threshold, that needs to be crossed to transition from `high` to `low` states.

*See also: [Analog Threshold Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/analog_threshold#configuration-variables)*

upper.docs:
**float**: Upper threshold, that needs to be crossed to transition from `low` to `high` states.

*See also: [Analog Threshold Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/analog_threshold#configuration-variables)*

threshold.docs:
**float**: Configures the reference for comparison. Accepts either a shorthand

*See also: [Analog Threshold Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/analog_threshold#configuration-variables)*
